edges.reason: msg.sender drives the eligibility and balance checks inside ClaimReward.
block.timestamp gates whether the caller may claim a reward.
ClaimReward performs an external token migration call before completing state settlement.
ClaimReward performs an external call to update the next claim date after value transfer.
msg.sender is forwarded as the recipient of the migrated reward tokens.
checkReward return value becomes the reward amount used by ClaimReward.
checkReward provides the value assigned to the usdtAmount local.
The claimed amount is added into _claimTotal via SafeMath.
usdtAmount is the operand of the _claimTotal.add accumulation.
setArgus assigns the CarbonCoin reference to cbc.
setArgus assigns the Argu reference to argu.
setArgus caches the pair address returned by cbc.uniswapV2Pair().
_argu parameter flows into the argu state variable.
_cbc parameter flows into the cbc state variable.
The usdt IERC20 instance is constructed from the _usdt address.
_CalculateReward executes the multiplication/division reward math.
currentBalance is multiplied into the reward numerator.
currentUsdtPool is multiplied into the reward numerator.
cTotalSupply is the denominator of the reward division.
multiplier scales the numerator in the reward math.
usdtReward holds the result of the arithmetic operation.
checkReward computes circulating supply via chained SafeMath subtraction.
checkRewardForExactAddr computes circulating supply via chained SafeMath subtraction.
msg.sender is used to fetch the caller balance and reward in checkReward.
msg.sender is checked against argu.canInvokeMe in checkRewardForExactAddr.
The addr parameter is the subject of the reward computation.
The addr parameter is forwarded to argu.getNextAvailableClaimDate.
The addr parameter is forwarded to argu.isExcludedFromReward.
checkReward delegates reward computation to _CalculateReward.
checkRewardForExactAddr delegates reward computation to _CalculateReward.
argu provides eligibility checks and claim-date updates inside ClaimReward.
cbc is queried for balances and used for the reward migration call.
usdt.balanceOf is read to size the reward pool in checkReward.
getTotalClaimedRewards returns the _claimTotal state value.
getTotalRewardToken reads usdt.balanceOf of the cbc contract.
getRewardCycleBlock proxies to argu.getRewardCycleBlock.
getNextAvailableClaimDate proxies to the argu contract.
getExcludeFromReward proxies to argu.isExcludedFromReward.
The usdtAmount local is produced by the checkReward call.
The checkReward circulating supply local is the result of the subtraction chain.
The checkRewardForExactAddr circulating supply local is the result of the subtraction chain.

normalization_plan.reason: The Argu argument exists only to populate the argu state variable inside setArgus.
The CarbonCoin argument exists only to populate the cbc state variable inside setArgus.
The addr parameter is only forwarded from getNextAvailableClaimDate to the argu proxy call.
The addr parameter is only forwarded from getExcludeFromReward to the argu proxy call.
The addr parameter is used only within the checkRewardForExactAddr reward computation.
currentBalance is consumed solely by the arithmetic reward computation.
currentUsdtPool is consumed solely by the arithmetic reward computation.
cTotalSupply is consumed solely as the divisor of the reward computation.
The usdtAmount local is the transient reward value flowing into migration and accumulation inside ClaimReward.
multiplier is a constant literal used only as an operand of the reward arithmetic.
usdtReward holds the direct result of the reward arithmetic expression.
This local is just the intermediate result of the chained subtraction in checkReward.
This local is just the intermediate result of the chained subtraction in checkRewardForExactAddr.
